# Muscle_Tendon_States

[Project home](../../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

Muscle_Tendon_States

Computed intact-cat forward results. The columns and named arrays below describe the simulated quantities. [Simulation results](../simulation_report.md).

- [elastic_tendon_length_m.csv](elastic_tendon_length_m.csv) — Computed elastic tendon length in metres; compare with tendon slack length to determine stretch.
- [fiber_length_m.csv](fiber_length_m.csv) — Computed muscle-fiber length in metres, distinct from total muscle–tendon path length.
- [fiber_velocity_m_s.csv](fiber_velocity_m_s.csv) — Computed fiber shortening or lengthening rate in metres per second.
- [normalized_fiber_length.csv](normalized_fiber_length.csv) — Fiber length divided by optimal fiber length; a dimensionless ratio used in force–length relationships.
- [tendon_strain.csv](tendon_strain.csv) — Dimensionless tendon extension relative to slack length, (length − slack length) / slack length.
- [whole_MTU_length_m.csv](whole_MTU_length_m.csv) — whole MTU length m — table with named columns.
